Thanks! I'm replying primarily to mention that the Logan vibe is intentional; this series was inspired by my fascination with the recent Legion TV series, Animorphs, and Logan.

An early iteration had the Lab-Rats meeting up with the one remaining member of Tau-5 — battered and half-mad, no longer able to regenerate/resurrect, with all their other team-members having been roughly consolidated into a single brain-space (resulting in fractured multiple consciousnesses). Which, I mean — other than the multiple identities — is pretty much Logan.

I only dumped that idea after realizing it was too similar to the premise behind Machine-Head.

I think I'm in love with this series. The characters and their unique abilities, the setting, the way intricate details are woven into each and every line. It's such a satisfying read. And the Clef cameo, and the lore you built around the pond, and the time you took to set that up…

I could be listing things I like all day. Very well-done, +1.

Also: does anyone else get Logan vibes from this series?
